runs.message: The payment portal failed. Can I pay on the next working day?
runs.note: evidence from section 2 and the 24-hour rule stated
runs.response:
Yes, you can pay on the next working day without incurring a late fee, provided you meet the following conditions:

* **Document the error:** Save a screenshot of the error and any transaction reference number [student_handbook.md#s2-1].
* **Report within 24 hours:** Raise a support request with the Accounts Office within 24 hours of the failed payment and before the due date, attaching the screenshot or transaction reference [student_handbook.md#s2-1].

If the payment failure is reported and documented within 24 hours, payment on the next working day will not attract a late fee [student_handbook.md#s2-1]. However, if it is not reported within 24 hours, the standard late fee will apply [student_handbook.md#s2-1].
